title: Iatridis 1997b NP equilibrium shear modulus mu(inf) vs degeneration

quantity.name: equilibrium shear modulus mu(inf)
quantity.definition: mu*G(inf) from fitted relaxation function (equilibrium after 600 s)

source.authors: Iatridis JC, Setton LA, Weidenbaum M, Mow VC
source.sample: 19 NP cylinders (8 mm diameter, 1.78+-0.35 mm thick), one per disc from 19 spines (L2-L3 n=1, L3-L4 n=16, L4-L5 n=2); normal (grade I) n=7, mild (II-III) n=5, severe (IV-V) n=7

protocol.summary: Frozen NP cylinders (8 mm, one per disc) (8 mm trephine, sledge microtome), tested in a humidity chamber in torsional shear (Rheometrics RMS-800, parallel plates) at 10% compressive offset strain; dynamic frequency sweep at shear strain amplitude 0.01 rad, 1-100 rad/s; then fast-ramp (0.025 s) stress relaxation at 0.05, 0.10, 0.15 rad; shear stress/strain at sample periphery. Linear viscoelastic law with variable-amplitude relaxation spectrum fitted to relaxation at 0.10 rad: mu = instantaneous shear modulus, mu(inf) = mu*G(inf) equilibrium modulus. Water content by lyophilisation.
how_to_simulate: Model an 8 mm NP disc (~1.8 mm thick) in torsion with 10% compressive offset
Apply a fast ramp (0.025 s) to 0.10 rad shear strain and hold 600 s
Report instantaneous (peak/strain) and equilibrium shear moduli

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 read from 200-dpi render (mean +- SD). mu and mu(inf) are parameters of the authors' viscoelastic law fitted per specimen to measured relaxation (not raw measurements). |G*| vs grade only in Fig 1 (not digitised). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
